limitations: Full browser matrix FAILED: WebKit questions strict runtime diagnostic remains for R6; Chrome271/WebKit245 are passing cases, not full-matrix acceptance.
Windows host and real Docker only; native Linux/macOS, Firefox, remote CI and full release smoke not run.
Directory anchors and NOFOLLOW do not provide an OS sandbox against arbitrary concurrent ancestor replacement.
POSIX mode/Windows ACL must be retained; unavailable workspace POSIX ownership is explicitly reported in FileChange metadata; private JSON ownership remains strict.
Terminal/todo/queue lifetime retention caps remain explicit; no automatic historical garbage collection.
No power-loss/directory-fsync certification; old migration prefixes without source fingerprints still require exact matching.
Browser earlier strict failures and overlapping invalid evidence runs are preserved; only run k is final. M10.5.9 remains LOCAL_PARTIAL_CI_PENDING.
